In [[3017 BBY]], [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] launched an '''attack''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] during the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict]]. The battle saw the destruction of [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of Alsakan [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] by [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]].
